Asha: Follow-up from today's RFC: we need a pragmatic surface for precision profiles. Two options: tiny preset set + signed overrides, or full DSL. Which way?

Ben: Presets + signed overrides. Keeps runtime cheap and telemetry sane.

Rita: Agree but whitelist overrides strictly: only allow kv_cache_mode and attn_window. No per-layer scales or weight transforms.

Asha: Runtime must have deterministic fallback: invalid token -> preset default. No attempting to apply partial overrides.

ops-bot: ALERT: canary created precision-presets-fastpath -> 2% for 6h.

Ben: Validator service compiles override -> returns compiled_id + short token. Runtime does local cache lookup keyed by compiled_id. If miss, rare fetch.

Rita: Telemetry: emit (preset, coarse_override_bucket, safety_tier). Avoid emitting full token except in traces. Also track compile_failures with reason tag.

Asha: Private deployments: disabled by default. Dedicated allowed via SRE review. Hosted: allowed with quota.

Ben: I'll prototype token format and cache keys. Rita: can you draft whitelist? I'll add canary plan.

Asha: Great—I'll update the RFC with these decisions and timeline.
